positions.as_written: Taking fluid out under vision, where the imaging also decides whether the collection should be aspirated at all.
Apply Doppler to exclude a vascular lesion, which is the step that must not be skipped.
Keep the needle in plane and watch the collection decrease, which confirms the tip.
A vascular lesion must be excluded before any posterior aspiration, and that is a procedural rule rather than a preference.
